[P1] 酷玩岛 世界经典童话双语绘本 外研社点读书

[P2] 萤火虫 世界经典童话双语绘本
外研社点读书
Sleeping Beauty
睡美人
（德）格林兄弟 著
外语教学与研究出版社
FOREIGN LANGUAGE TEACHING AND RESEARCH PRESS
北京 BEIJING

[P3] 从前，有一座美丽的城堡，城堡里住着国王和王后。他们什么都不缺，就是一直都没有孩子。国王和王后日日夜夜地祈祷，盼望上天能赐给他们一个孩子。
一天，刚下过雨，天边挂着一道美丽的彩虹。王后虔诚地在河边祈祷：“请让我有个孩子吧！”突然，一只青蛙跳出水面对王后说：“你的愿望会实现的！不久以后，你就会有个女儿！”

[P4] 国王和王后高兴极了。国王说：“我要举办一场盛大的宴会，让全国人民都知道这个好消息！”王后说：“是的，陛下。咱们要把仙女们请来，请她们赐福给咱们的小宝贝。”国王点头，“嗯，仙女们将是我们最重要的客人！

没过多久，王后果然生下了一个小公主。她有着雪一样白的肌肤、蓝宝石一样的大眼睛和像玫瑰花瓣一样娇美的嘴唇。

[P5] 王国里住着十三个仙女，其中十二个都非常善良，另外一个却邪恶而歹毒。国王只有十二只金盘子可供仙女使用，因此那个邪恶的仙女理所当然地没有受到邀请。盛大的宴会隆重地举行了，仙女们为小公主送上一份份有魔力的祝福：“她将拥有最高尚的品德！”“她将成为王国里最漂亮的人！”“她将成为世界上最聪明的人！”……

[P6] 当第十二个仙女正要送出祝福时，
宴会厅里突然响起邪恶仙女愤怒的咆哮声：“为什么不请我？我要让你们付出代价！公主将在十五岁时被一个纺锤扎伤，然后死去！”说完，邪恶仙女转身离去。
宾客们都惊呆了，王后流下了伤心的眼泪，“天哪，这该怎么办呢……”
这时，第十二个仙女走过来，对王后说：“王后，我虽然不能阻止那个魔咒应验，但我可以改变它——在公主十五岁生日那天，她不会死去，但她会沉睡一百年，直到她的真爱出现。”

[P7] 为了避免诅咒应验，国王下令把全国的纺车、纺锤全部烧掉，并且不允许任何人向公主提起邪恶仙女的诅咒。
一年一年过去，小公主渐渐长大。善良仙女们的祝福也一个接着一个地实现。小公主是那么聪明美丽、温柔善良，所有人都喜欢她。

[P8] 转眼间，就到了公主十五岁的生日。这天早晨，在城堡里的其他人都还在睡着的时候，公主早早地就起床了。她一个人走出房间，走啊走，来到花园角落里的一座旧塔前。她爬上那座塔，看到一扇小门，门锁上插着一把生了锈的钥匙。
“屋子里是什么呢？”公主打开门，啊，里面真黑！还不时发出吱吱呀呀的声音。公主仔细一看，才发现里面坐着一个穿着长袍的老太婆。

[P9] “早上好，老奶奶！请问您在干什么呀？”公主有礼貌地问。
老太婆说：“哦，我在纺纱呢。”“啊？那是什么？我怎么从来没见过呢？”公主指着一个纺锤问。老太婆露出一丝不易察觉的笑容，她说：“这是纺锤，纺纱用的。这可是王国里唯一的一个，你要拿过去看看吗？”天真的公主高兴地伸出手来。谁知刚一碰到纺锤，她的手就被扎破了。紧接着公主便昏倒在旁边的床上，陷入了沉睡。老太婆满意地笑了，原来她就是邪恶仙女！

[P10] 就在公主倒下的这一刻，整座城堡也陷入沉睡之中。国王和王后才刚刚起床，又再次昏睡过去；正在服侍国王和王后的仆人也软绵绵地瘫倒在地上；小马站在马厩里睡着了；小狗趴在院子里睡着了；小火苗儿在灶膛里睡着了；厨师正在斥责一个做了错事的童工，可现在他们两个也定在那儿睡着了……

[P11] 荆棘丛渐渐包围了这座安静的城堡，年复一年，越长越高。慢慢地，整座城堡都被罩在这茂密的荆棘丛里。
于是，关于这个王国，有一个传说流传开来：一位美丽的沉睡着的公主，正等待着一位王子的拯救。这个说法流传了一代又一代，不知有多少个王子不远千里而来，就为去城堡里拯救公主，但他们都没能砍断那些荆棘。

[P12] 很多年以后，又有一个王子来到这个王国，准备去救公主。有好心人告诫他：“那片荆棘非常危险，好多王子去了都没能回来。”
年轻英俊的王子笑着说：“公主已经沉睡了一百年，现在正是合适的时机。”
就这样，王子来到沉睡中的城堡。他惊讶地发现，那些荆棘上居然开出了美丽的玫瑰花。而王子每走近一步，玫瑰花丛就自动向两边分开，为他让路。

[P13] 一路上，王子看到了马厩里熟睡的小马和院子里趴着的小狗。走进城堡后，他又看到了房间里熟睡的仆人、厨房里静止的火苗儿以及宝座上安睡的国王和王后。
王子暗暗惊叹：“这里可真安静啊，我都能听得见自己的呼吸声！”

[P14] 王子开始挨个儿房间寻找公主，最后来到那座旧塔前。他爬上楼梯，推开小屋的门。啊！公主原来在这里！
王子注视着公主娇美的脸庞，“啊，她真的好美！”王子情不自禁地俯下身子吻了她一下。就在王子的嘴唇触碰到公主的那一瞬间，公主睁开了她蓝宝石般的眼睛。她望着王子，甜蜜地笑了。
王子握住公主的手，深情地说：“亲爱的，从今天开始，就让我给你幸福吧！”

[P15] 王子和公主一起走下那座旧塔。就在这时，整座城堡都苏醒了！国王、王后和仆人们你看看我，我看看你，都不记得发生了什么事。小马醒了，打了个响鼻；小狗醒了，在院子里蹦蹦跳跳；小火苗儿醒了，在灶膛里呼哧呼哧地笑着；而可怜的童工刚一醒来，就听见厨师对他大吼大叫……这座沉睡了一百年的城堡终于恢复了生机。

[P16] 不久以后，王子和公主举行了盛大的婚礼。全国上下一片欢乐与祥和，所有人都把最美丽的祝福献给他们。
王子与公主手牵着手，漫步在玫瑰花的海洋里。金色的阳光笼罩着他们，他们的目光与微笑，都是那么甜蜜！从此以后，王子与公主幸福地生活在一起。

[P3] Once upon a time, there was a beautiful castle where a king and queen lived. They had everything, except for a child. The king and queen prayed day and night, hoping heaven would give them a child.
One day, after the rain, a beautiful rainbow hung in the sky. The queen prayed sincerely by the river: "Please let me have a child!" Suddenly, a frog jumped out of the water and said to the queen: "Your wish will come true! Soon, you will have a daughter!"

[P4] The king and queen were overjoyed. The king said, "I will hold a grand banquet so that all the people in the kingdom can know this wonderful news!" The queen said, "Yes, Your Majesty. We should invite the fairies to come, and ask them to bless our little treasure." The king nodded, "Yes, the fairies will be our most important guests!

Not long after, the queen gave birth to a little princess. She had skin as white as snow, eyes as big as sapphires, and lips as delicate as rose petals.

[P5] In the kingdom, there lived thirteen fairies, twelve of whom were very kind, while the thirteenth was evil and malicious. The king had only twelve golden plates to offer the fairies, so the wicked fairy was naturally not invited. The grand banquet was held with great ceremony, and the fairies bestowed magical blessings upon the little princess: "She will possess the noblest virtues!" "She will become the most beautiful person in the kingdom!" "She will become the smartest person in the world!" ...

[P6] As the twelfth fairy was about to give her blessing,
the banquet hall suddenly echoed with the evil fairy's angry roar: 'Why didn't you invite me? I will make you pay! The princess will be pricked by a spindle at fifteen and then die!'说完，邪恶仙女转身离去。
Guests were stunned, and the queen shed tears of sorrow, 'Oh my, what shall we do...'
At that moment, the twelfth fairy approached the queen and said, 'Queen, although I cannot prevent that curse from coming true, I can change it—on the princess's fifteenth birthday, she will not die, but she will sleep for a hundred years, until her true love appears.'

[P7] To prevent the curse from coming true, the king ordered all spinning wheels and spindles in the kingdom to be burned, and forbade anyone from mentioning the evil fairy's curse to the princess.
Year after year passed, and the little princess grew up. The blessings from the kind fairies came true one by one. The princess was so intelligent, beautiful, gentle, and kind that everyone loved her.

[P8] In the blink of an eye, it was the princess's fifteenth birthday. That morning, while everyone else in the castle was still asleep, the princess got up early. She walked out of her room alone, wandered around, and arrived at an old tower in the corner of the garden. She climbed up the tower and saw a small door with a rusty key in the lock.
"What's inside the house?" The princess opened the door. Oh, it was so dark inside! And it kept making creaking sounds. The princess looked carefully and finally saw an old woman wearing a long robe sitting inside.

[P9] "Good morning, grandma! What are you doing?" the princess asked politely.
"Oh, I'm spinning," the old woman said. "Huh? What is that? I've never seen it before," the princess asked, pointing at a spindle. The old woman gave a barely noticeable smile and said, "This is a spindle, used for spinning. It's the only one in the kingdom. Would you like to take a look?" The innocent princess happily reached out her hand. But as soon as she touched the spindle, her hand was pricked. Immediately, the princess collapsed onto the bed beside her and fell into a deep sleep. The old woman smiled with satisfaction—she was the evil fairy!

[P10] At the very moment the princess fell, the entire castle sank into slumber. The king and queen, who had just woken up, fell asleep again; the servants attending to them collapsed softly to the ground; the little horse slept in the stable; the puppy slept in the yard; the tiny flame slept in the hearth; the cook was scolding a young worker for a mistake, but now both of them were frozen in place, asleep...

[P11] Thorny vines gradually surrounded this quiet castle, year after year, growing taller and taller. Slowly, the entire castle was enveloped in the dense thorny vines.
Thus, a legend spread about this kingdom: a beautiful sleeping princess, waiting for a prince to rescue her. This story passed down from generation to generation, and countless princes came from far and wide to rescue the princess, but none of them could cut through those thorns.

[P12] Many years later, another prince arrived in the kingdom, ready to rescue the princess. A kind-hearted person warned him: "That thorny thicket is very dangerous; many princes who went there never returned." 
 The young and handsome prince smiled and said: "The princess has slept for a hundred years; now is the perfect time." 
 Thus, the prince arrived at the sleeping castle. To his surprise, he found that beautiful roses had bloomed on the thorns. And with every step he took, the rose bushes parted automatically to make way for him.

[P13] Along the way, the prince saw a little horse sleeping in the stable and a puppy lying in the yard. After entering the castle, he saw servants sleeping in their rooms, a still flame in the kitchen, and the king and queen sleeping peacefully on the throne.
The prince whispered in amazement: "It's so quiet here, I can even hear my own breath!"

[P14] The prince began searching room by room for the princess, and finally arrived at the old tower. He climbed the stairs and pushed open the door of the small room. Ah! The princess was here!
The prince gazed at the princess's beautiful face. "Ah, she is truly beautiful!" The prince couldn't help but lean down and kissed her. At the very moment the prince's lips touched the princess, she opened her eyes, bright as sapphires. She looked at the prince and smiled sweetly.
The prince took the princess's hand and said tenderly, "My dear, from today on, let me give you happiness!"

[P15] The prince and princess walked down the old tower together. At that moment, the entire castle awoke! The king, queen, and servants looked at each other, none remembering what had happened. The little horse woke up and snorted; the puppy woke up and jumped around in the yard; the tiny flame woke up and chuckled in the fireplace; and the poor child laborer, just waking, heard the cook shouting at him... This castle, asleep for a hundred years, finally regained its vitality.

[P16] Not long after, the prince and princess held a grand wedding. The entire kingdom was filled with joy and peace, and everyone offered them the most beautiful blessings.
The prince and princess held hands, strolling through an ocean of roses. Golden sunlight surrounded them, and their gazes and smiles were so sweet! From then on, the prince and princess lived happily ever after.
